_comment: FIXED values the production-host record must carry, known before N1. NOT a qualification record and never shipped: scripts/build-qualification-record.py refuses a bundle whose measured values differ from any of these. Changing a value here is a reviewed decision (a different host, image, filesystem or kernel is a different record). Sources per value in RECORD-CUT.md.

filesystem.features: has_journal ext_attr resize_inode dir_index filetype needs_recovery extent 64bit flex_bg sparse_super large_file huge_file dir_nlink extra_isize metadata_csum

declared._comment: Production declarations the record's gate F evidence must state exactly. M = 1 GiB: owner decision 2026-11-05 (#124 comment 6671007334), subject to Ops' capacity proof, which passes (infinity-core !189 @ cc1cab9). Not an E7 PASS: E7 is evaluated against this budget when it completes. The staging example stays at 256 MiB.
